answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The ferrous edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 185 clones produces a signature the lagoon analysis flags immediately. An adversary must thus build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the karst settlement applies the void retroactively. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
